[David] Welcome to the SubClub Podcast, a show dedicated to the best practices for building and growing app businesses. We sit down with the entrepreneurs, investors, and builders behind the most successful apps in the world, to learn from their successes and failures. SubClub is brought to you by Revenue Cat. Thousands of the world's best apps trust Revenue Cat to power in-app purchases, manage customers, and grow revenue across iOS, Android, and the web. You can learn more at revenuecat.com. Let's get into the show. Hey, Adam. Thanks so much for joining us on the podcast today.

[David] And Jacob, always nice to have you on.

[David] So, Adam, I wanted to kick things off talking about the pivot. So it wasn't a pivot in that you pivoted inside the same company, but you were doing enterprise chatbots with CleverBots. Why did you switch into consumer language learning? And then especially, why did you switch into consumer language learning when Duolingo is like the 900-pound gorilla and everybody's like, oh, don't compete with them?

[Adam Turaev] To explain this pivot, I would say. So together with my co-founders, Anton and Ilya, we're schoolmates, actually, and we've been building projects together and always dreaming about building something innovative and giving value to people worldwide. And there are so many pain points that you can resolve. And we lived personally through language pain point, I would say, and language barrier pain point, to be more precise. At the same time, we started with conversational AI. We really dived deep into this sector and started thinking about, all right, how can we leverage conversational AI and give value to enterprise customers and build our first company called CleverBots? It was back in 2017, so three long before LLM era.
